name: Sambhv Steel Tubes Ltd
title: Sambhv Steel Tubes Ltd - 544430 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA/ton hit INR9,500 on inventory-cost lag and HR coil spike, but management guides Q1 FY27 to only INR7,500-8,000 while adding 1.2 MMTPA Kesda capacity and INR200cr more capex.

capex.peers_comment: Management said Chinese producers face similar cost increases and imports will come in for lack of Indian capacity.
capex.quote: So we have not impacted with the shortage of PNG or LNG.

triggers.label: Kesda Phase 1 adds 3.6 lakh t SS
triggers.quote: The first phase of expansion having 3,60,000 ton per annum of stainless steel capacity remain on track for commissioning in quarter four, financial year 2027.

triggers.label: Q4 EBITDA/t INR9,500 ex-sponge iron
triggers.quote: EBITDA per ton stood at 9,500 excluding sponge iron sales.

triggers.label: Q1 FY27 EBITDA/t INR7,500-8,000
triggers.quote: So we would like to give you a guidance of INR7,500 to INR8,000 per ton for Q1 FY27.

triggers.quote: So some or the other import will happen from China now.
